subject: Fee carve / scope lift request for CloudGen pilot — Order Form CG-842
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Peter Liu <peter.liu@cloudgen.com>, contracts@cloudgen.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-18T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fee carve / scope lift request for CloudGen pilot — Order Form CG-842

Hi Peter / CloudGen contracts team —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As discussed, CloudGen would like to accelerate the pilot and add an additional 100k tokens/day throughput for the next 8 weeks (scope lift). They are asking for a one-time fee carve against the implementation fee and a temporary reduction to the monthly minimum while the pilot runs.

Quick summary of request: 
- Add: +100k tokens/day (pilot-only) for 8 weeks (temporary capacity add)
- Fee ask: 50% carve from the Implementation Fee (one-time) applied to this pilot
- Billing: prorate the monthly minimum for the pilot window, revert afterwards

I've attached a very small proposed change order draft for legal to redline. We need legal input on whether this qualifies as a temporary amendment to the Order Form vs. an Exhibit change to the MSA, and whether we should route this as a fully executed change order or via a signed amendment plus billing credit. The customer is pushing to get the pilot running next week.

Attachment: proposed_change_order_draft.docx (draft change order — scope and fee carve)

Ask: Laura / Rishi — can you advise on (a) recommended contract approach, (b) minimal redlines we should include to protect our implementation SOW and acceptance criteria, and (c) whether we need a countersignature from our finance/legal execs for the fee carve?

I can coordinate a short sync with CloudGen if helpful — they'd prefer a 30-minute call.

Thanks —
Vanessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0148

--
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-18T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fee carve / scope lift request for CloudGen pilot — Order Form CG-842

Vanessa —

Thanks for the heads-up and the draft. Quick read and initial guidance below. I attached an annotated redline with comments for the change-order path (see redline_annotated.docx).

High-level recommendation: route this as a temporary Change Order to the Order Form (not an MSA exhibit rewrite). Reason: the change is time-boxed and operational (capacity and a pilot fee tweak). Keep the MSA intact; that reduces downstream risk.

Key redline items to include now: 
- Explicit pilot effective/expiration dates tied to the +100k tokens/day capacity.
- Billing language: prorate monthly minimum and define the exact credit mechanics (one-time credit vs. offset across next invoice cycles).
- Implementation SOW protection: add clause that any scope expansion/larger rollouts post-pilot require separate SOW & pricing review.
- Liability cap/usage risk: limit any overage exposure and require CloudGen to acknowledge data handling and acceptance criteria for pilot features.
- Signatory authority: add explicit signatory names for both parties to avoid later countersign disputes.

On the fee carve: a 50% carve will likely need internal finance approval. Rishi — can you weigh in on whether we can approve this at the regional sales ops level or if we need EB sign-off? If finance requires escalation, we should get that on paper before the customer signs.

Operational ask: Vanessa, please confirm the billing impact (expected dollar credit) and whether CloudGen wants the credit applied immediately or amortized. Also, confirm the rollout timeline (they asked for next week which is tight).

Attachment: redline_annotated.docx (comments inline)

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Fee carve / scope lift request for CloudGen pilot — Order Form CG-842

Hi Vanessa / Laura / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side before we sign any change order: 
1) Pilot dates: we want the +100k tokens/day to start 2025-09-23 and run through 2025-11-17. Please confirm those exact effective/expiry dates in the change order.
2) Fee carve mechanics: CloudGen would prefer the 50% implementation carve as an invoice credit applied on receipt of the change order signature (not amortized). Is that feasible?
3) Acceptance criteria: we will test two integrations during the pilot. Can we capture the acceptance tests in the change order or should those live in a short SOW attachment?

We are ready to sign once the change order explicitly lists the pilot window, the credit mechanism, and the acceptance path. If Redwood prefers, we can sign a simple change order and separately add the SOW attachment that lists the tests.

We can do a 30‑minute call tomorrow (09/20) in the AM PST to finalize — 9:00am or 10:00am work for our team.

Thanks —
Peter Liu
Head of Platform Integrations, CloudGen
peter.liu@cloudgen.com

Thanks all — quick internal note and next steps.

Laura — thanks for the annotated redline; that path makes sense (temporary change order). Rishi, can you confirm finance approvals threshold? If we can approve up to 40% regionally, we should escalate the additional 10% to Sales Ops/Finance. I'll pull the expected dollar impact and post it here by EOD.

Peter — we'll take your preference: list pilot dates exactly (9/23–11/17) in the change order and apply the 50% implementation fee as an on-signature invoice credit. Laura recommended we attach a short SOW for the acceptance tests rather than putting detailed test steps inline in the change order; we'll include that as SOW Attachment A.

Action items: 
- Vanessa: finalize billing impact and send to Rishi (ETA: EOD 9/19)

- Laura: finalize legal redlines on temporary change order and SOW attachment (ETA: morning 9/20)
- Vanessa: schedule 30-minute call with CloudGen for 9/20 10:00am PST (I will send the invite after we confirm Rishi's path)

I'll post the dollar figures and a DocuSign link once we have internal approval.
